__meta.note: Base catalogue. Every other locale is scored against this one; see www/js/i18n.js.

__translatorNotes.literal: Keys listed in a locale's "__literal" array are expected to stay identical to English. File extensions (.srwb, .ipynb, .py) and kernel names (Python, Bash, Prolog, Lua, R) are identifiers, not prose — translating them would break what users type and search for.
__translatorNotes.rtl: In right-to-left locales, Latin identifiers keep their own direction inside the sentence. Write the sentence naturally in your language and leave the identifier as-is; the browser handles the bidirectional run.
__translatorNotes.placeholders: {name} placeholders are substituted at runtime. Keep them exactly as written; they may be reordered to suit your language's word order.

__senses.Cell-Notebook: The unit of code and its output in a notebook document. Not biological, not a spreadsheet cell, not a prison cell.
__senses.Run-Execute: To execute code. Not 'run' as in move quickly, and not a run/series of things.
__senses.Kernel-Interpreter: The language runtime that executes a cell. Not an operating-system kernel and not a seed.
__senses.Notebook-Document: A computational notebook document, in the Jupyter sense. Not a paper notebook and not a laptop.
__senses.Workbook-Bundle: A saved SciREPL bundle of notebooks and their packages. Distinct from Notebook-Document.
__senses.Package-Library: An installable software library. Not a parcel or a wrapper.
__senses.Language-Interface: The display language of the app's own menus and messages — the locale.
__senses.Language-Programming: The programming language a cell's code is written in (Python, Prolog, R…).
__senses.Scale-Size: Physical on-screen size. Not a musical scale, a weighing scale, or a map ratio.
__senses.Margin-Layout: Empty space at the edge of the interface. A layout term, not a printing margin or a profit margin.
__senses.Theme-Colours: A named set of interface colours. Not a topic or motif.
__senses.Reset-RestoreDefaults: Restore the default values. Not 'restart the device' and not 'erase data'.
__senses.Apply-Commit: Commit the pending changes in this dialog. Not 'apply for' something.
__senses.Import-LoadFile: Read a file into the app. Not importing goods.
__senses.Export-SaveFile: Write the user's work out to a file. Not exporting goods.
__senses.Session-AppState: The current working state of the app. Not a meeting or a class.

__context.appearance.themeAuto: Follow the operating system's light/dark setting.
__context.appearance.customise: Opens an editor. Trailing ellipsis means 'this opens a dialog' — keep it.
__context.appearance.buttonPreview: A live sample shown next to the control, not a preview of a document.
__context.appearance.advancedCss: CSS is a technical identifier and stays as-is.
__context.appearance.languageDetect: Detect the user's language from their device settings.
__context.appearance.languagePartial: Shown in a dropdown: the language name, then how much of the UI is translated.
__context.tour.editCellLanguage.body: 'All→' is a button label on screen; keep the arrow. 'cell' is a notebook cell.
__context.menu.showTour: Replays the first-run introduction. 'Tour' as in a guided walkthrough of the interface.

strings.menu.title: Menu
strings.appearance.title: Appearance
strings.appearance.topMarginHelp: Space above the header, so the app does not sit under the device status bar. Auto follows the device's reported safe area. Set 0 to remove it entirely.
strings.appearance.buttonScaleHelp: Scales the header buttons. Larger buttons are easier to hit on a touchscreen.
strings.appearance.themeEditorHelp: A theme is a set of colour variables. Edit the values below, then apply. Unknown names and non-colour values are rejected.
strings.appearance.advancedCssHelp: Raw CSS, applied last. This can make the app unusable — use Reset to defaults to recover.
strings.appearance.languageHelp: Only languages with a usable translation are listed. File extensions and kernel names stay in their original form in every language.
strings.tour.language.title: Choose your display language
strings.tour.language.body: This is the language of SciREPL's own menus and messages. It is separate from the programming language your code is written in.
strings.tour.menu.title: The menu
strings.tour.menu.body: Notebooks, import and export, packages, settings and appearance all live here.
strings.tour.help.title: Help
strings.tour.help.body: Documentation, the privacy policy, and this tour if you want to see it again.
strings.tour.newCellLanguage.title: Programming language for new cells
strings.tour.newCellLanguage.body: Pick the language your next cell will run in. Python, Prolog, Bash, JavaScript, R, Lua, TypR and ClojureScript are available.
strings.tour.editCell.title: Editing a cell
strings.tour.editCell.body: The pencil on any cell reopens it for editing and re-running. It appears once you have run something.
strings.tour.editCellLanguage.title: Changing a cell's programming language
strings.tour.editCellLanguage.body: While editing, this selector changes that one cell's language. "All→" applies your choice to every code cell in the notebook.
